LEGACY.//: New Game Plus legacies (Battle Re-work Part 12, note 05; Cam, 16 October: build the whole project, play-test at the end). Your last game's highest class gives its gift; its level gives free talent points for that class (one for every pointsPer levels, up to maxPoints -- worth about the class's first 10 levels, the Mathematician's target); every technique you learned comes with you; each game you finish adds a prestige mark, and from freeRespecAt marks one respec a game is free. A Beast Master brings one battle pet from the old Pen, back at battleLevel. An Arcane who had learnt Necromancy gets the Necromancer's gift instead (Part 13).

hunter.line: Ranger Ash left a bundle by your door: "Nets, snares and a knife. You'll know what to do."

thief.line: Nell's ledger has your name in it, crossed out and paid: two daggers and a little poison.

berserker.line: Old Thorvald sent a maul. "SWING IT," says the note. That's the whole note.

paladin.line: Sister Maren blessed a buckler for you, and five flasks of holy water.

arcane.line: The Archmage remembers you: a staff of air and three hundred runes, "to start with".

beastmaster.line: Warden Briar kept one back for you. "Knew you'd come round again."

necromancer.line: A bone staff on your doorstep, and three little lights in a jar. No note. The Archmage never was one for notes.
